text:
ops-bot: ALERT: apiserver 5xx spike detected in us-west1 (10m window) - sustained 20% error rate, paging eng-sre
alyssa: seeing timeouts to etcd leader when apiserver writes try to commit, stack traces show proposal timeouts
jordan: logs: "rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded" from etcd client on controller-manager pods
marco: network graph shows BGP flap on the regional router ~1762129500-1762129800, coincides with spike
alyssa: also a ton of large image pulls for model shards on new gpu nodes — egress bandwidth hit 95% on nat gateway
sre-oncall: running `kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide` — controller-manager is CrashLoopBackOff on 3 masters
marco: extracted etcd logs (truncated):
```
2025-10-04T14:17:22.123Z etcdserver: publish error: raft: failed to send to peer 2: write tcp 10.0.2.5:2380->10.0.2.6:2380: write: connection reset by peer
2025-10-04T14:17:24.456Z rafthttp: setConn for 10.0.2.6 timed out
2025-10-04T14:17:30.789Z etcdserver: apply entry err: etcdserver: request timed out
```
alyssa: proposal latency >3s, leader is staying but followers have high RTT, quorum degraded intermittently
jordan: quick diagnostics: `curl -s http://metrics.us-west1.internal/egress | jq '.nat_utilization'` -> 0.93
marco: SNAT port exhaustion on the NAT gateway is likely given so many concurrent image pulls + registry retries
sre-oncall: mitigation candidate: drain gpu onboarding nodes to reduce pull concurrency, temporarily redirect new onboarding to us-east1 pool
alyssa: +1 on draining. Also advise scaling down parallel model shard rollout from 50->5 per region in the autoscaler hook
dev-platform: can we flip a low-risk route? ops-bot can throttle registry pulls via rate-limit policy if we push a patch to the image pull controller
jordan: for immediate relief I'm going to taint and cordon the 8 newest nodes and scale down gpu-onboard-asg by 30%
marco: I submitted NAT support ticket to cloud with priority, but ETA 40m for port increase
sre-oncall: applying cordon now: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-*-onboard`
alyssa: after cordon, apiserver errors dropped to ~4% within two minutes — watching for regression
jordan: controller-manager restarted and stabilized after follower reconnects, etcd proposal latency back to ~200ms
marco: postmortem notes: root cause = concurrent large-layer image pulls + regional BGP instability -> nat SNAT port exhaustion -> high RTT to etcd followers -> apiserver proposal timeouts and controller-manager crashes
alyssa: action items: 1) add pull-rate caps to onboarding controller 2) add SNAT port monitoring & autoscale 3) change default onboarding region for heavy model images 4) run chaos test for image-pull egress saturation
sre-oncall: created ticket SRE-2025-1782 and assigned to dev-platform + networking, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-2025-1782
dev-platform: will add pull concurrency flag to the onboarding controller, aiming for patch by EOD
alyssa: thanks team. keep this thread updated with cloud ticket progress and any rollback steps. :thumbsup:
